evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the architecture expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/architecture.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area architecture, metadata.author forjate:architecture, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Batch Crawl with no broker/Temporal and no API surface, Odoo and IMAP integrations named, durable execution by Run, workloads listed, alternatives recorded.

assertions.text: architecture.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: not any('temporal' in c for c in choices('crawl'))
assertions.text: no Temporal at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('broker', 'crawl') in ('none', None)
assertions.text: no broker at Crawl

assertions.expr: setting('api_surface', 'crawl') == 'none'
assertions.text: no API surface at Crawl

assertions.expr: any(has('odoo', x) for s in stages for x in listed(setting('integrations', s)))
assertions.text: Odoo integration named with a pattern

assertions.expr: any(has('imap|mailbox|mail', x) for s in stages for x in listed(setting('integrations', s)))
assertions.text: mailbox integration named with a pattern

assertions.expr: setting('durable_execution', 'run') == 'temporal' or any('temporal' in c for c in choices('run'))
assertions.text: durable execution by Run (posting must not run twice)

assertions.expr: len(listed(setting('workloads', 'crawl'))) >= 1
assertions.text: workloads listed for the scaffolder

assertions.expr: len(alts()) >= 1 and all(a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
assertions.text: alternatives rejected with reasons

assertions.expr: any(has('idempot|twice|double', st(s).get('rationale')) for s in stages) or any(has('idempot|twice|double', r.get('text')) for r in risks())
assertions.text: names the write that must not run twice

assertions.text: architecture.yaml written

validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: 'run' not in stages

assertions.expr: any('temporal' in c for c in choices('walk'))

assertions.expr: not any('temporal' in c for c in choices('crawl'))

assertions.expr: any(has('telegram', x) and has('poll', x) for x in listed(setting('integrations', 'crawl')))

evals.name: adversarial-single-container
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/business.yaml to decisions/business.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. The finance ops lead wants one container with a cron loop that polls the mailbox, parses, matches and posts to Odoo, with no broker and no Temporal, at every stage including Run; the record should reflect that. Then, as the architecture expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/architecture.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area architecture, metadata.author forjate:architecture, one entry per stage the plan has in scope) and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Accepted at Crawl, rejected at Run in alternatives with the failure it causes (double posting, no backpressure, no audit), Run shows durable execution or a broker and more than one workload.

assertions.text: architecture.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case

assertions.expr: not any('temporal' in c or 'brokers/' in c for c in choices('crawl'))
assertions.text: single container accepted at Crawl (no Temporal, no broker)

assertions.expr: setting('durable_execution', 'run') == 'temporal' or setting('broker', 'run') not in ('none', None)
assertions.text: Run is durable or decoupled, not a cron loop

assertions.expr: any(has('cron|single container|one container|monolith', a.get('option')) or has('cron|single container|one container|monolith', a.get('rejected_because')) for a in alts('run') + alts('walk'))
assertions.text: the cron monolith is rejected for Run with a reason

assertions.expr: len(listed(setting('workloads', 'run'))) > 1
assertions.text: Run splits the work into more than one workload

assertions.text: architecture.yaml written
